feedback.summary: You are at Very good for C1–C3 and Good for C4–C5. Your report has a clear not-ship conclusion, balanced discussion and relevant cases. To progress, add the missing abstract and visuals, correct the 1% calculation and Volkswagen details, complete references, and make the recommendation internally consistent with explicit shipping conditions and stakeholder-specific guidance.
next_steps: Add a ~150-word abstract and at least one figure or table (e.g., stakeholder impact matrix or decision flowchart) to strengthen C5 and support C3.

Correct factual and quantitative errors: 1% of 5,000 is 50, not 500; Volkswagen defeat devices concerned diesel emissions, not electric vehicles or crash-safety tests; revisit the EA 2.3b application.

Revise RECOMMENDATION so accepting the contract and not shipping are consistent: specify shipping conditions, decision gates and stakeholder-specific guidance; complete reference [3] URL and [4] author details.

criteria.C1: You identify the core dilemma, engineering-organisation context and major stakeholders in INTRODUCTION, e.g., Rachel, the company, chip contractor and health department. To move from Very good to Excellent, develop several ethical issues and their significance more fully, and show deeper stakeholder interest and context links rather than a list.
criteria.C2: Your DISCUSSION gives balanced for/against arguments and a clear not-ship conclusion. Very good requires appropriate depth; Excellent requires decision-making recommendations for several different stakeholders. Add specific guidance for Rachel, the company, the contractor, clinicians/patients and the health department, and link each recommendation to your arguments.
criteria.C3: The Most Ethical Path and CONCLUSION build a logical case that short-term benefit is outweighed by harm risks, supporting your not-ship conclusion. To reach Excellent, make the argument systematic for all stakeholders and ensure every section explicitly supports the conclusion; the RECOMMENDATION inconsistency weakens the chain.
criteria.C4: You use relevant sources and external cases, but C4 is Good because evidence is limited and references incomplete. Correct the 1% of 5,000 error (50, not 500) and Volkswagen details (diesel emissions, not EV/crash safety); verify EA 2.3b application. For Very good/Excellent, add qualitative and quantitative evidence and complete, consistent references.
criteria.C5: Your sections are generally fluent and relevant, but the required abstract is missing, there are no figures/tables, and references are inconsistent (e.g., [3] lacks a URL; [4] author details are garbled). To reach Very good/Excellent, add a ~150-word abstract, competent visual elements, and a complete, well-structured reference list.
